gates.detail: Live capture requires physically disconnected VM confirmation
Startup heuristics only; no automatic deadband assignment
Existing pulse protocol has no descending-duty hold sweep
52 groups; minimum 10 distinct trials per group
Fall-rate alternatives are not advertised in current pulse protocol
Neutral register checks, net and absolute observed stop-tail counts
Actual C watchdog tested on host; powered heartbeat-loss trace not captured

sensor_integration.gyro_interpretation: 20ms sampling of gyro angular rate includes real mechanical vibration; a difference between PWM-on and neutral is not by itself proof of electrical EMI.
